title: pericallis malvifolia
intro: Pericallis malvifolia, commonly known as the Cape marguerite, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its leaves and stems offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pericallis malvifolia include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antiviral agent, making it useful in wound healing and treating infections. The bioactive constituents of Pericallis malvifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
